title: Purple Eye Monster
description: A glossy, bulbous purple creature with a large central orange eye and a green curled stalk on top sits in the center of the frame. It has dripping, pointed tentacles at its base, surrounded by swirling purple and green smoke with faint ghostly faces and spiral patterns in the background.
prompt: A grotesque bulbous purple monster made of glossy dripping ooze, featuring one large central orange eye with a black pupil and a green curly stalk growing from its top, sits centered in a pool of reflective liquid. It has multiple pointed purple drips at its base. The background consists of swirling purple and green smoke containing faint ghostly faces and spiral patterns, in a dark surreal fantasy style.
